Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page**  
Title: *State Dinner Desserts*  
URL: https://www.whitehousehistory.org/galleries/state-dinner-desserts  

**Evidence**  
| # | Dessert Title (as displayed) | Date of Dinner | Dessert / Topping Mentioned | Quote |
|---|------------------------------|----------------|-----------------------------|-------|
| 1 | *Dinner in Honor of His Excellency Menachem Begin, Prime Minister of Israel* | April 15, 1980 | orange sorbet cake, dairy‑free whipped topping | “I baked at the White House … the dairy‑free whipped topping that was to frost the cake … the caramel‑dipped orange segments” |
| 2 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency the Premier of The State Council of the People's Republic of China* | January 10, 1984 | pomegranate sorbet with lychees and raspberries, sabayon | “I’d made a pomegranate sorbet with fresh lychees … garnishing the dessert with sabayon” |
| 3 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency the President of Mexico Miguel de la Madrid Hurtado And Mrs. Paloma de la Madrid* | May 15, 1984 | tequila mousse with kiwi and coconut sorbet | “A tequila mousse accompanied by kiwi and coconut sorbet” |
| 4 | *Dinner Honoring Her Majesty Sirikit, Queen of Thailand* | March 11, 1985 | pulled‑sugar baskets with fruit sorbets | “I made pulled‑sugar baskets … filled each one with an assortment of fruit sorbets” |
| 5 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency the General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and Mrs. Gorbachev* | December 8, 1987 | honey vanilla ice cream with tea parfait, chocolate base, meringue cookies | “a sphere of honey vanilla ice cream filled with a tea parfait” |
| 6 | *Dinner Honoring The Right Honorable The Prime Minister of Canada and Mrs. Mulroney* | April 27, 1988 | pineapple Champagne sorbet in meringue shell, maple‑leaf cookies | “I made this pineapple Champagne sorbet, served in a meringue shell” |
| 7 | *Dinner Honoring Her Majesty Queen Margrethe II of Denmark and His Royal Highness Prince Henrik of Denmark* | February 20, 1991 | raspberry soufflés | “I planned to produce twenty‑two large raspberry souffles” |
| 8 | *Dinner Honoring Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II and His Royal Highness Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh* | May 14, 1991 | pistachio marquise, marzipan “cobblestone” street | “I decided to fashion a chocolate carriage … filled with pistachio marquise” |
| 9 | *Dinner Honoring Their Majesties the Emperor and Empress of Japan* | June 13, 1994 | white almond ice cream balls with cherry sorbet | “white almond ice cream balls filled with red cherry sorbet” |
|10 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency Helmut Kohl, Chancellor of the Federal Republic of Germany* | February 9, 1995 | hazelnut ice cream with coffee‑rum mousse and meringue | “I made a hazelnut ice cream mold filled with coffee rum mousse” |
|11 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency the President of the French Republic and Mrs. Chirac* | February 1, 1996 | apple and cherry sorbet  | “I planned to alternate caramel puffs with rows of apple and cherry sorbet” |
|12 | *Dinner Honoring the Honorable Professor Romano Prodi, President of the Council of Ministers of the Republic of Italy* | May 6, 1998 | brioche cake soaked in Amaretto, with vanilla custard, peach slices, honey meringue, chestnut ice‑cream tower | “This dessert, a brioche cake soaked in Amaretto syrup, … a replica of one of the Bolognese towers” |
|13 | *Dinner Honoring His Excellency Carlos Saul Menem, President of the Argentine Nation* | January 11, 1999 | frozen dulce de leche with roasted pineapple, coconut snowballs, caramel walnuts | “a frozen dulce de leche served with roasted pineapple, coconut snowballs, and caramel walnuts” |
|14 | *Dinner in Honor of Her Excellency Gloria Macapagal‑Arroyo, President of the Republic of The Philippines* | May 19, 2003 | mango ice‑cream, coconut mousse, caramel and almond nougat stands | “the leis were draped over mango ice‑cream and coconut mousse molds” |
